title: B2C Commerce dw.json
description: Connection and project configuration for B2C Commerce tooling. See https://salesforcecommercecloud.github.io/b2c-developer-tooling/guide/configuration.html

active.description: Use this entry as the default instance.

hostname.description: Instance hostname, without a URL path (e.g. `abcd-001.dx.commercecloud.salesforce.com`). Env: `SFCC_SERVER`.

server.description: Alternate spelling of `hostname`. Instance hostname, without a URL path (e.g. `abcd-001.dx.commercecloud.salesforce.com`). Env: `SFCC_SERVER`.

webdavHostname.description: Alternate spelling of `webdav-hostname`. Separate WebDAV hostname. Env: `SFCC_WEBDAV_SERVER`.

webdav-server.description: Alternate spelling of `webdav-hostname`. Separate WebDAV hostname. Env: `SFCC_WEBDAV_SERVER`.

secure-server.description: Alternate spelling of `webdav-hostname`. Separate WebDAV hostname. Env: `SFCC_WEBDAV_SERVER`.

secureHostname.description: Alternate spelling of `webdav-hostname`. Separate WebDAV hostname. Env: `SFCC_WEBDAV_SERVER`.

code-version.description: Default code version for operations that accept one. Env: `SFCC_CODE_VERSION`.

codeVersion.description: Alternate spelling of `code-version`. Default code version for operations that accept one. Env: `SFCC_CODE_VERSION`.

shortCode.description: Alternate spelling of `short-code`. SCAPI short code. Env: `SFCC_SHORTCODE`.

scapi-shortcode.description: Alternate spelling of `short-code`. SCAPI short code. Env: `SFCC_SHORTCODE`.

tenant-id.description: Tenant or organization ID, such as `abcd_001` or `f_ecom_abcd_001`. Env: `SFCC_TENANT_ID`.

tenantId.description: Alternate spelling of `tenant-id`. Tenant or organization ID, such as `abcd_001` or `f_ecom_abcd_001`. Env: `SFCC_TENANT_ID`.

site-id.description: Default site/channel ID for supported site and shopper operations. Env: `SFCC_SITE_ID`.

siteId.description: Alternate spelling of `site-id`. Default site/channel ID for supported site and shopper operations. Env: `SFCC_SITE_ID`.

api-backend.description: API backend for operations supporting both SCAPI and OCAPI. `auto` (default) prefers SCAPI with OCAPI fallback. Env: `SFCC_API_BACKEND`.

apiBackend.description: Alternate spelling of `api-backend`. API backend for operations supporting both SCAPI and OCAPI. `auto` (default) prefers SCAPI with OCAPI fallback. Env: `SFCC_API_BACKEND`.

client-id.description: Account Manager API client ID. Env: `SFCC_CLIENT_ID`.

clientId.description: Alternate spelling of `client-id`. Account Manager API client ID. Env: `SFCC_CLIENT_ID`.

clientSecret.description: Alternate spelling of `client-secret`. Account Manager client secret. Env: `SFCC_CLIENT_SECRET`.

oauth-scopes.description: Requested OAuth scopes. Scope grants must be configured on the API client. Env: `SFCC_OAUTH_SCOPES` (comma-separated).

oauthScopes.description: Alternate spelling of `oauth-scopes`. Requested OAuth scopes. Scope grants must be configured on the API client. Env: `SFCC_OAUTH_SCOPES` (comma-separated).

jwt-cert-path.description: PEM certificate path for JWT authentication. Env: `SFCC_JWT_CERT`; flag: `--jwt-cert`.

jwtCertPath.description: Alternate spelling of `jwt-cert-path`. PEM certificate path for JWT authentication. Env: `SFCC_JWT_CERT`; flag: `--jwt-cert`.

jwt-key-path.description: PEM private key path for JWT authentication. Env: `SFCC_JWT_KEY`.

jwtKeyPath.description: Alternate spelling of `jwt-key-path`. PEM private key path for JWT authentication. Env: `SFCC_JWT_KEY`.

jwt-passphrase.description: Passphrase for an encrypted JWT private key. Env: `SFCC_JWT_PASSPHRASE`.

jwtPassphrase.description: Alternate spelling of `jwt-passphrase`. Passphrase for an encrypted JWT private key. Env: `SFCC_JWT_PASSPHRASE`.

auth-methods.description: Ordered list of allowed authentication methods. Do not combine with `user-auth`. Env: `SFCC_AUTH_METHODS` (comma-separated).

authMethods.description: Alternate spelling of `auth-methods`. Ordered list of allowed authentication methods. Do not combine with `user-auth`. Env: `SFCC_AUTH_METHODS` (comma-separated).

user-auth.description: Shorthand for `"auth-methods": ["user"]` (browser login). Do not combine with `auth-methods`.

userAuth.description: Alternate spelling of `user-auth`. Shorthand for `"auth-methods": ["user"]` (browser login). Do not combine with `auth-methods`.

accountManagerHost.description: Alternate spelling of `account-manager-host`. Account Manager hostname override. Env: `SFCC_ACCOUNT_MANAGER_HOST`.

client-auth-method.description: How client credentials are sent to Account Manager (default `basic`). Env: `SFCC_CLIENT_AUTH_METHOD`; flag: `--client-auth-method`.

clientAuthMethod.description: Alternate spelling of `client-auth-method`. How client credentials are sent to Account Manager (default `basic`). Env: `SFCC_CLIENT_AUTH_METHOD`; flag: `--client-auth-method`.

slas-client-id.description: Shopper Login and API Access Service (SLAS) client ID. Env: `SFCC_SLAS_CLIENT_ID`.

slasClientId.description: Alternate spelling of `slas-client-id`. Shopper Login and API Access Service (SLAS) client ID. Env: `SFCC_SLAS_CLIENT_ID`.

slas-client-secret.description: Secret for a private SLAS client; omit for public clients. Env: `SFCC_SLAS_CLIENT_SECRET`.

slasClientSecret.description: Alternate spelling of `slas-client-secret`. Secret for a private SLAS client; omit for public clients. Env: `SFCC_SLAS_CLIENT_SECRET`.

username.description: Business Manager username (typically an email address) for WebDAV. Env: `SFCC_USERNAME`.

certificate.description: Path to a PKCS12 (`.p12` / `.pfx`) client certificate for mTLS. Env: `SFCC_CERTIFICATE`.

certificatePassphrase.description: Alternate spelling of `certificate-passphrase`. Client certificate passphrase. Env: `SFCC_CERTIFICATE_PASSPHRASE`.

passphrase.description: Alternate spelling of `certificate-passphrase`. Client certificate passphrase. Env: `SFCC_CERTIFICATE_PASSPHRASE`.

self-signed.description: Disable server certificate verification (default `false`). Not required just because you use mTLS. Env: `SFCC_SELFSIGNED`.

selfSigned.description: Alternate spelling of `self-signed`. Disable server certificate verification (default `false`). Not required just because you use mTLS. Env: `SFCC_SELFSIGNED`.

selfsigned.description: Alternate spelling of `self-signed`. Disable server certificate verification (default `false`). Not required just because you use mTLS. Env: `SFCC_SELFSIGNED`.

cartridges.description: Cartridge names for deploy/watch filtering and IDE discovery. Array, or a colon/comma-separated string. Env: `SFCC_CARTRIDGES`.

cartridgesPath.description: Alternate spelling of `cartridges`. Cartridge names for deploy/watch filtering and IDE discovery. Array, or a colon/comma-separated string. Env: `SFCC_CARTRIDGES`.

auto-upload.description: Automatically upload code changes from the VS Code extension.

autoUpload.description: Alternate spelling of `auto-upload`. Automatically upload code changes from the VS Code extension.

contentLibrary.description: Alternate spelling of `content-library`. Default library for content list/export.

catalogs.description: Catalog IDs for WebDAV browsing. Env: `SFCC_CATALOGS`.

siteLibrary.description: Whether this is a site-private library.

libraries.description: Content library IDs, as strings or `{"id": "RefArch", "siteLibrary": true}` entries. Env: `SFCC_LIBRARIES`.

asset-query.description: JSON dot-paths for finding static asset URLs in content (default `["image.path"]`). Env: `SFCC_ASSET_QUERY`.

assetQuery.description: Alternate spelling of `asset-query`. JSON dot-paths for finding static asset URLs in content (default `["image.path"]`). Env: `SFCC_ASSET_QUERY`.

import-set-exclude.description: Project-relative directories to exclude recursively from import-set discovery. Env: `SFCC_IMPORT_SET_EXCLUDE`.

importSetExclude.description: Alternate spelling of `import-set-exclude`. Project-relative directories to exclude recursively from import-set discovery. Env: `SFCC_IMPORT_SET_EXCLUDE`.

docs-categories.description: Documentation category allowlist for supported searches. Env: `SFCC_DOCS_CATEGORIES`.

docsCategories.description: Alternate spelling of `docs-categories`. Documentation category allowlist for supported searches. Env: `SFCC_DOCS_CATEGORIES`.

scapi-schemas.description: Local SCAPI OpenAPI JSON files or directories (relative to the project directory), or http(s) URLs, for MCP code mode. Env: `SFCC_SCAPI_SCHEMAS`.

scapiSchemas.description: Alternate spelling of `scapi-schemas`. Local SCAPI OpenAPI JSON files or directories (relative to the project directory), or http(s) URLs, for MCP code mode. Env: `SFCC_SCAPI_SCHEMAS`.

sandbox-api-host.description: On-Demand Sandbox API hostname override. Env: `SFCC_SANDBOX_API_HOST`.

sandboxApiHost.description: Alternate spelling of `sandbox-api-host`. On-Demand Sandbox API hostname override. Env: `SFCC_SANDBOX_API_HOST`.

cipHost.description: Alternate spelling of `cip-host`. CIP analytics host override. Env: `SFCC_CIP_HOST`.

safety.description: Per-instance safety restrictions and confirmation rules. See the Safety Mode guide.

confirm.description: Require interactive confirmation for blocked operations instead of refusing them.

rules.description: Ordered rules; the first match wins.

mrtApiKey.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-api-key`. Managed Runtime API key. Env: `MRT_API_KEY`.

mrt-project.description: Managed Runtime project slug (storefront ID for SCAPI MRT operations). Env: `MRT_PROJECT`.

mrtProject.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-project`. Managed Runtime project slug (storefront ID for SCAPI MRT operations). Env: `MRT_PROJECT`.

mrtEnvironment.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-environment`. Managed Runtime target environment. Env: `MRT_ENVIRONMENT`.

mrt-origin.description: Managed Runtime API origin override. Env: `MRT_CLOUD_ORIGIN`.

mrtOrigin.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-origin`. Managed Runtime API origin override. Env: `MRT_CLOUD_ORIGIN`.

cloudOrigin.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-origin`. Managed Runtime API origin override. Env: `MRT_CLOUD_ORIGIN`.

mrt-backend.description: Managed Runtime backend for supported operations (default `auto`). Env: `MRT_BACKEND`.

mrtBackend.description: Alternate spelling of `mrt-backend`. Managed Runtime backend for supported operations (default `auto`). Env: `MRT_BACKEND`.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

configs.description: Named instance entries. Select one with `--instance` / `SFCC_INSTANCE`, or mark one `active`.
